newsitem.title: JAPAN: SAKAKIBARA TO MEET WITH SUMMERS ON WED IN U.S.-MOF.
newsitem.headline: SAKAKIBARA TO MEET WITH SUMMERS ON WED IN U.S.-MOF.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, Japan's vice finance minister for international affairs, is scheduled to meet with U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers on Wednesday in Washington D.C., a Ministry of Finance official said on Tuesday.
Sakakibara will leave Tokyo on Tuesday to attend a meeting to be held in Aspen, Colorado, from Wednesday until Saturday, the official said.
Details of the meeting were not immediately available.
The official said Sakakibara will make a stop in Washington to meet with Summers before going on to Aspen.
Sakakibara is scheduled to return to Japan on Sunday.
